g.text: Synthetic source-contribution membership: common versus local coordination
80 independent paired held-out groups; 31 public count/geometry/time features; balanced IN/OUT prior.
Models fit on training groups; thresholds calibrated separately. Intervals condition on those fitted models.
Utility: same 10 m / 1 s query, unknown missing support. Exact-count control bypasses policy.
Attack failure does not establish privacy. Synthetic population; no physical-presence or universal guarantee.
